comment: QUESTS.md F1, Spare joins - the gate. Spare's three beats played (the first is his application); Shim's washer, carried, and her afterwards; Gudgeon's form page reading out the three sections of Form P-9 one at a time - Spare heard in full, the family met (not Cotter), the airship (SW_AIRSHIP) - then the form issued; Spare's whole conversation with 'Not yet'; the short ask with no room; and the Eighty-Four window. Faces read off the live message window. The argument is q_spa0_argument.

steps.eval: window._lines = []; window._faces = []; const add = Game_Message.prototype.add; Game_Message.prototype.add = function (t) { window._lines.push(t); return add.call(this, t); }; const sf = Game_Message.prototype.setFaceImage; Game_Message.prototype.setFaceImage = function (n, i) { if (n) window._faces.push(n + ':' + i); return sf.call(this, n, i); }; window._mark = () => { window._tropes = $gameVariables.value(2); window._blushes = $gameVariables.value(7); window._lines = []; window._faces = []; window._troops = []; window._members = []; }; window._mark(); window._pick = undefined; const sc = Game_Message.prototype.setChoices; Game_Message.prototype.setChoices = function (c, d, k) { return sc.call(this, c, window._pick === undefined ? d : window._pick, k); }; window._has = s => window._lines.some(l => l.includes(s));
